fact.description: A concise learned fact or preference extracted from conversation, e.g. 'User prefers revenue figures net of IPL fees' or 'User's top buyer is LeadFlow'

category.description: What kind of memory this is

source_conversation_id.description: Conversation this memory was learned from. Nullable.

confidence.description: How confident the bot is in this memory, 1-5

times_referenced.description: How many times this memory has been used as context

active.description: False when the user dismisses or corrects this memory
